title: Page 149
transc:
Geo D. Sheldon  Wash'n Aug. 11th 11 1/2 am 1864 
Grapes Fence Florence For Pandora Biggs Vinton zebra
Provision and water the Continental to bring whiskey
Saxon Quadroon Torch Waxy and Persia a dispatch
preparing by Ivory amirs send her with it
to Hit on Head zodiac Wick ham of
sailing youth Meigs Belsher Italys dispatch gone forward


John Horner  Wash'n Aug 11th 1864 230 Pm
Grapes Aug Fence Henrietta For Abe Wake Man Esq
Post Master Frog unity Alexander Keith the Walnut agent
at Halifax to whom the Penfield stopped by you
last winter were addressed is in France Zodiac It
is likely that he is now getting letters from
Fool where he has recently been & perhaps from
other Vernons zebra His oakum would be of immense
advantage to the Spark unity Can you arrange it
Yoke Infant Zodiac To Homer Please examine your office
business & see if any thing been rec'd for
or sent by Keith during past three days &
also look out for anything which may be received
or offered in his name zebra His is probably
in correspondence with Norris & sons Frog answer quick
